title: How to Train Your Dragon
synopsis: On the island of Berk, where fighting dragons is a way of life, a young Viking named Hiccup changes the fate of his village forever when he befriends Toothless, a rare and dangerous dragon from the Night Fury species.

title: Kung Fu Panda
synopsis: By chance, the noodle-loving panda Po is chosen to become the legendary Dragon Warrior. He embarks on an epic training journey with the Furious Five to protect the Valley of Peace from the fearsome snow leopard Tai Lung.

title: Shrek
synopsis: The reclusive green ogre Shrek sets out with his talkative donkey on a quest to rescue Princess Fiona from a fire-breathing dragon, hoping to reclaim the peace of his swamp in a witty parody of classic fairy tales.

title: Madagascar
synopsis: Four pampered animals from New York City's Central Park Zoo suddenly find themselves on the shores of wild Madagascar, where they must adapt to nature and the island's lively lemur kingdom.

title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
synopsis: After losing eight of his nine lives, the adventurous Puss in Boots sets off on a legendary journey into the Dark Forest to find the mythical Wishing Star and restore his lost lives.

title: The Prince of Egypt
synopsis: This timeless visual and musical epic tells the story of the historic struggle between adoptive brothers Moses and Ramses in ancient Egypt, exploring human bonds and a divine calling.

title: Megamind
synopsis: After finally defeating his heroic rival Metro Man, the brilliant blue-headed Megamind discovers that life without an opponent is unbearably dull. He decides to create a new hero, who soon turns into an unstoppable threat.

title: Rise of the Guardians
synopsis: When the evil spirit Pitch Black threatens to plunge the world into nightmares and darkness, the legendary Guardians of Childhood join forces with rebellious Jack Frost to protect the dreams of children everywhere.

title: The Croods
synopsis: After their cave is destroyed, the prehistoric Crood family must embark on an extraordinary journey through a spectacular world filled with strange creatures and surprises as they search for a new place in the future.

title: The Wild Robot
synopsis: A crash leaves the intelligent robot Roz stranded on an uninhabited island. She learns to adapt to the harsh wilderness, forms deep friendships with forest animals, and becomes the adoptive mother of an orphaned gosling.
